title: A name made only of invisible / right-to-left-override characters is accepted; the driver's bell then shows reversed text and the request card shows a blank name
steps: POST /api/auth/register with name "\u200B\u200B\u202E" (two zero-width spaces + RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE), verify, sign in (account f2-zw@e.ntu.edu.sg)
Top up, request Hall B -> Main Gate, book a live driver (f2-d1)
As the driver open the bell (/notifications) and the journey page (/driver/journey/<id>)
expected: Register refuses a name with no visible letters (400 'Enter your name'), and strips bidi control characters so no text can be flipped.
actual: 201 Created; GET /api/auth/me name is the invisible string. Driver bell renders the notification '<name> asked to join your trip.' as '.pirt ruoy nioj ot deksa' (the U+202E flips the rest of the line). The request card shows an empty name line above 'No ratings yet' with Accept/Decline. GET /api/journeys/:id/requests passenger.firstName = '\u200B\u200B\u202E'.
where: shared/src/endpoints/account.ts:17 (name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80): trim() does not remove U+200B/U+202E, no letter check); the message is built from firstName in the notification text
demo_impact: Not in scenes 1-6 with the seeded people; would only show if someone registers such a name live. A driver cannot tell who is asking.

title: Two drivers can save the same vehicle plate, and plates are not normalised (SF2001A, sf2001a, 'SF 2001 A' all accepted)
expected: The second driver is refused (409 'This plate is already registered') and the plate is stored in one canonical form (upper case, no spaces), so a rider can identify the car by its plate.
actual: All four calls 200, e.g. {"vehiclePlate":"SF2001A","vehicleModel":"Car","payNowId":"91234567","dailyPaidTrips":0} for both drivers; then {"vehiclePlate":"sf2001a"...} and {"vehiclePlate":"SF 2001 A"...} stored as typed.
where: server/prisma/schema.prisma:163 (vehiclePlate String, no @unique); server/src/services/PresetService.ts:31-41 upserts the body as is; shared/src/endpoints/account.ts DriverProfileBody (only trim/min/max)
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-2006/4da488d3-701a-505d-8bca-74c0047c18de/scratchpad/panel2/find-f2/p5.js (output lines 'b1 dup plate', 'b1 dup plate lower', 'b1 plate sp')
demo_impact: No visible effect in scenes 1-6 (the plate is not shown to riders yet, C-015), but it matters as soon as it is.

title: Every rider in a shared trip receives the other riders' pickup:status and noshow:open socket events (their booking id, status, driver distance and ETA to their pickup)
steps: Driver f2-d1 goes live SHARING; riders f2-p1 (Hall B) and f2-p2 (Hall A) book; driver accepts both and starts
Both riders and the driver connect the socket and journey:join
Driver sends location:update near Hall A, then near Hall B
expected: pickup:status / noshow:open about a booking reach only that booking's passenger and the driver (emit to the user room), not the whole journey room.
actual: p1's socket received: pickup:status {"bookingId":"cmw2ui6fh00l87dz5wschlgtj" (p2's booking),"status":"ARRIVED","distanceM":25,"etaSec":5}, and p2 received p1's {"status":"APPROACHING","distanceM":223,"etaSec":40}. The client keys pickups by bookingId so the screen is not wrong, but the data reaches the other rider.
where: server/src/realtime/gateway.ts:128-137 (NoShowWindowOpened and PickupStatusChanged use realtime.emitToJourney instead of emitToUser(passengerId) + driver)
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-2006/4da488d3-701a-505d-8bca-74c0047c18de/scratchpad/panel2/find-f2/p8.js (event log at the end of its output)
demo_impact: Invisible on screen in scene 4-5; only seen in the browser's WebSocket frames.

title: Two tabs: after switching to driver in tab B, tab A still says 'Passenger' and its Find a ride fails with 'Switch to your passenger role to do that.'
steps: Sign in as a both-roles user (f2-b2), choose passenger, open /passenger/request in tab A
In tab B (same browser) switch to driver (POST /api/me/active-role DRIVER, as the pill does)
Back in tab A (pill still reads 'Passenger'), pick Hall B -> Library and tap Find a ride
expected: Tab A notices the role changed (re-reads /api/auth/me on focus or on a role FORBIDDEN) and shows driver Home, or the server keeps each tab's session role; at least the message should not ask to switch to the role the pill already shows.
actual: Tab A shows the red line 'Switch to your passenger role to do that.' under the form while the top pill still reads 'Passenger'. Opening Wallet in tab A then flips the pill to 'Driver'.
where: server/src/middleware/requireAuth.ts:27 (user.lastActiveRole wins over the token's activeRole, so one tab's switch changes every tab); the client does not refetch auth.me on a role FORBIDDEN
demo_impact: Could show if the presenter keeps a passenger and a driver tab of the same both-roles account; the seeded personas each hold one role, so scenes 1-6 as written are not affected.

title: Going live and switching to passenger at the same moment leaves a passenger session with a LIVE journey (driver routes refused)
steps: Both-roles user f2-b2 acting as driver, with vehicle and preset
Send POST /api/journeys (go live) and, 30 ms later, POST /api/me/active-role {role:'PASSENGER'} (two tabs or a double action)
expected: One of the two is refused: the switch with 'Finish or cancel your trip first, then switch role.' (409), because the journey is live by the time it commits.
actual: Both succeed: go live 201 status LIVE, switch 200 activeRole PASSENGER. GET /api/journeys/mine then 403 'Switch to your driver role to do that.' while the journey is visible to riders. Before the integration change at 01:12 (f2091e0) switching back was also refused (409 ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION, account f2-b1 stuck until the journey expired); on the current code switching back to DRIVER works and the journey can be cancelled.
where: server/src/services/RoleService.ts:36-41 (tripRoles check is a read outside any lock) racing JourneyService.goLive, which does not re-check the active role inside its transaction
demo_impact: Unlikely in scenes 1-6 (needs two simultaneous actions).

title: Two sign-ups for the same e-mail at the same time: the loser gets 409 CONFLICT 'This conflicts with existing data.' with the column name, not EMAIL_TAKEN
steps: Send three POST /api/auth/register with the same new e-mail in parallel (two tabs, or a double submit)
expected: One 201; the others 409 EMAIL_TAKEN with the normal 'already registered' sentence and the 'Sign in instead' link.
actual: reg0 201 {userId}; reg1 and reg2 409 {"code":"CONFLICT","message":"This conflicts with existing data.","details":{"fields":["ntuEmail"]}}
where: server/src/services/AuthService.ts register: findUnique check, then slow bcrypt, then create (check-then-act); the P2002 is mapped generically in server/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts (Prisma P2002 -> CONFLICT with DB field names)
